items.t: Mizuho Calls Rocket Lab’s Business Model “Among Our Favorites.” It Still Sees 6% Downside
items.sum: Key TakeawaysMizuho initiated coverage of Rocket Lab with an Underperform rating and a $40 price target, 6% below the stock’s price. Mizuho likes Rocket Lab’s business but argues that its valuation already prices in much of its growth.

items.t: I’m Buying SpaceX Because There’s a Reasonable Case for $200 by January
items.sum: SpaceX just posted a massive profit swing, yet its shares keep sliding as a December lockup expiration looms. Can a business this strong outrun the wave of supply, or will dilution and valuation win first?

items.t: Rocket Lab Just Grew Revenue 73%. Its Next Chapter Could Be Even Bigger
items.sum: Rocket Lab's sales are surging, but its stock is sliding. Wall Street sees a big rebound ahead, yet one unfinished rocket and a hefty valuation stand between the company and that payoff. What would it take to get there?

items.t: Watching Space-Telecom Companies; FCC Authorizes 1 Million Satellites For Data Centers In Space'
Mizuho Sees 14% Downside in Rocket Lab Even After Its 69% Fall From May’s High
items.sum: Key TakeawaysMizuho initiated coverage of Rocket Lab with an Underperform rating and a $40 price target, 14% below the last close. Mizuho’s call looks right for now: even $40 is about 167x the normalized earnings analysts expect for 2028, and that estimate keeps falling.
